content:
**Quarry X3** is a location in the Cranberry Bog region of Appalachia.

There is a flooded quarry surrounded on all sides by steep rock walls. The breaks in the wall are a ramp on the western side and an embankment on the north and southeast corners. At the end of the ramp are some portable toilets and some explosives. One of the toilets contains a Cat Bowl and a Mr. Fuzzy yellow hard hat. A Mirelurk Queen lurks beneath the surface of the water and will attack if disturbed. A Steamer Trunk is underwater in the middle of the flooded quarry on a slope, near the northeast side.

On the northern end is an AMS shed containing a Weapons Workbench and a Nuka-Cola machine. Outside the shed are a truck, a trailer, and a suit of Power Armor.

- Potential Vault-Tec Bobblehead - Inside the trailer with the flag outside, on a metal desk.
- Potential Magazine - Southwest corner of the curve-roofed warehouse, on the middle metal shelf, left of the orange Toolbox, left of the Nuka-Cola machine.
- Power Armor Chassis with T-series armor pieces - At the edge of the road next to the modular building.
- Mr. Fuzzy Yellow Hard Hat - Inside a portable bathroom on the left.
- Potential Weapon Mod - On top of a cabinet inside the metal shack.

Quarry X3 appears in *Fallout 76*.
